svg.title: What an agent reads in a generated video project, and when
svg.desc: Portrait diagram. A bar per case shows kilobytes read, split into three layers: the Director Pattern starter, the template's own Director add-ons, and the video docs, crew and records. Saying hi reads 113 KB before the first reply; a one-line note reads 183.4 KB before it is saved; a script request has the Director read 292.6 KB before the writer starts, and the writer then reads 298.7 KB plus a transcript; a research worker reads 66.0 KB before acting. Video files are the largest share in every case. Below, the Director's reads are shown in order as fourteen grouped steps with three milestones, then the research worker's three grouped steps.
